about.text: Sour cream is a dairy product obtained by fermenting regular cream with certain kinds of lactic acid bacteria. The bacterial culture, which is introduced either deliberately or naturally, sours and thickens the cream. Its name comes from the production of lactic acid by bacterial fermentation, which is called souring.

how.text: In the United States, sour cream is cultured cream of at least 18 % fat; it may be thickened with stabilisers such as starch or gelatine.
